content: {"phoneNote":"The opening-hours section turns five identical 7.00–15.00 rows into a tall column of blue bars that pushes the services far down and reads like a chart with no information.","desktopNote":"The hero's call-to-action is a thin underlined text link next to a large empty band below, and the giant footer wordmark dwarfs the actual hero headline.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Collapse the five identical opening-hours bars into one line ('Pon–Pet 7.00–15.00') so the services and location come up sooner on both screens.","Give the hero a real primary button for calling and tighten the empty band under the desktop hero; drop the oversized footer wordmark to the headline size.","Replace the stock-feeling glass-crate and valley photos with imagery of finished work (shower cabins, mirrors, shopfronts) and add a small photo per service on desktop."],"blockers":[]}
